title: New on OTT 12-13 Nov 2026: Jailer 2 (Prime Video, 12 Nov); Ranabaali (Netflix), Student of the Year: After Dark (JioHotstar), Parivarik ManuRanjan (Sony LIV), 13 Nov
headline: Jailer 2 Streams Today, Ranabaali Friday: 4 New OTT Releases
caption:
Jailer 2, Nelson Dilipkumar's Tamil action film with Rajinikanth, streams on Prime Video from Thursday, 12 November, four weeks after it opened in cinemas on 15 October. You can watch it in Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam or Kannada.

On Friday, 13 November, Ranabaali, the Telugu period drama that opened in cinemas on 16 October, arrives on Netflix in Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Kannada and Malayalam. JioHotstar starts Student of the Year: After Dark, a Hindi series, and Sony LIV adds the Hindi film Parivarik ManuRanjan.

Did you see Jailer 2 in a cinema, or are you watching it at home this weekend?

Sources: Prime Video India, Netflix India, JioHotstar, Sony LIV, Khaleej Times, The Hollywood Reporter India, Outlook India, tbreak, Flickonclick
